```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to protecting and advancing reproductive health, rights, and justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe every woman should be able to access high-quality reproductive health care services, including safe and legal abortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will repeal the Title X domestic gag rule.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will restore federal funding for Planned Parenthood.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Planned Parenthood provides vital preventive and reproductive health care for millions of people, especially low-income people, and people of color, and LGBTQ+ people, including in underserved areas.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats oppose and will fight to overturn federal and state laws that create barriers to reproductive health and rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will repeal the Hyde Amendment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect and codify the right to reproductive freedom.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats condemn acts of violence, harassment, and intimidation of reproductive health providers, patients, and staff.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will address the discrimination and barriers that inhibit meaningful access to reproductive health care services, including those based on gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, income, disability, geography, and other factors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats oppose restrictions on medication abortion care that are inconsistent with the most recent medical and scientific evidence and that do not protect public health.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
